subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: After the stale workflow invariant is fixed, should ClawSweeper adopt the shared durable queue drainer, sealed requeue authority, and fail-closed active-ledger ceiling as its production repair contract?
rationale: The remaining code defect is mechanical, but overload recovery, centralized queue liveness, and authenticated requeue semantics are production operating choices that require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Adopt after the test fix
options.body: Update the stale invariant, require green exact-head checks, and operate the durable queue with fail-closed overload behavior.

options.title: Add overflow recovery first
options.body: Require and prove a bounded operator recovery mechanism before the new queue becomes production behavior.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Retain the existing repair model until maintainers are prepared to own the new liveness and authority interfaces.

recommendation.title: Adopt after the test fix
recommendation.body: Update the stale invariant, require green exact-head checks, and operate the durable queue with fail-closed overload behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest historical ownership signal across the repair area and is best positioned to decide its production operating contract.
